assessment.model_case: Projected mean is 1.38 shots, below the 1.5 line, from 18.0 minutes with a median of one. The case leans on a modest shooting rate rather than reduced ice time. Byram's listed absence could add Rinzel power-play time; whether recent games already reflect that is unclear.
assessment.price_case: DraftKings' main line is -110, and break-even needs slightly better than even-money win odds. Model fair odds are about -152, and the minimum is about -121. Two other books price the under as a modest favorite too, so the disagreement is mostly about degree.
assessment.context_case: Byram's listing is the relevant deployment context for a defenseman. Buffalo's starter is uncertain on a back-to-back. A tired Sabres team could lift Chicago's shot volume.

qualitative_review.countercase: If Rinzel absorbs Byram's power-play and top-pair minutes, his shot rate could exceed the modeled mean. Buffalo on the back half of a back-to-back could also let Chicago control play. The under shares game-flow exposure with the Östlund under.
